verdict.rationale: Hightouch's API guide documents scoping an API key to a group so it lacks admin access. It explicitly gives an AI tool using a key scoped to a Workspace viewer group as the example, so least-privilege agent credentials are a direct, first-party capability. Scoping appears to work only through group role assignment, and the depth of granularity is undocumented. missing for 10: fine-grained per-resource or per-action scopes, key expiry/rotation/revocation controls, MCP-specific credential scoping, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Scope a key to a group to keep it from having admin access. For example, an AI tool can use a key scoped to a group with the Workspace viewer role.
Authenticate each request by passing your API key as a bearer token in the `Authorization` header
Set up permissions, approvals, and ownership boundaries so each team has the right level of access.
